headline: PBOC Raises FX Reserve Ratio to Curb Yuan Rally Amid Record Surplus
summary: The People’s Bank of China intervened to raise the foreign exchange reserve requirement ratio to curb the yuan's appreciation, offering relief to exporters amid a record goods trade surplus of $938.1 billion.
why: Central bank intervention in foreign exchange reserve requirements directly affects currency appreciation momentum, export competitiveness, and broader macroeconomic liquidity in China.

impacts.name: Chinese yuan
impacts.why: PBOC raised FX reserve requirements to curb the yuan's sustained rally.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Raising the foreign exchange reserve requirement ratio increases the cost of holding foreign currency positions, directly dampening the yuan's appreciation trend.
